# Pull request checklist

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.vi.md)

## Summary
Describe the problem and the smallest coherent change.

## Verification
- [ ] tests added/updated when behavior changed
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] asset/notebook verification when relevant
- [ ] secret scan
- [ ] EN/VI documentation kept in sync
- [ ] no CI/mock result is presented as real Kaggle GPU evidence
